subject: Post-call: XyloTech trial evidence plan + weekly rendezvous
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@xylotech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — XyloTech trial evidence plan

Alex — thanks again for a productive 30m today. Quick recap from my side and suggested next steps so we can lock the POC timeline quickly.

Summary of what you said you need from the trial:
- Latency and cost numbers for your median prompt (approx. 600 tokens) and your peak parallelism (20 concurrent sessions).
- Data residency and audit logs for requests on private deployment (must stay in us-east-1).
- A minimal evaluation harness that runs your 6 canonical prompts and returns accuracy + hallucination flags for each run.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Average p95 latency < 250ms on hosted config for 600-token prompt at 20 concurrent sessions.
2) End-to-end integration of evaluation harness with nightly runs; pass rate >= 85% on canonical prompt set.
3) Evidence of request-level audit logs and KMS key integration for at-rest encryption.

Timeline I propose (two-week sprint cadence):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and sign mutual action plan — target DocuSign link below.
- Week 1: Kickoff + environment access (API keys, VPC peering test) + baseline run.
- Week 2: Run canonical prompt suite, iterate on prompts and routing, middle-of-week sync.
- Week 3: Final readout + handoff notes and recommended production config.

Ownership: Olga (PM lead) — trial coordination / ops; Marissa (CS) — onboarding & eval harness; Vivek (solutions) — model/quantization recommendations.

Attachments I'm sharing: draft SOW and a calendar invite for proposed weekly check-ins. If that aligns, can we aim to sign the SOW by EOD Tuesday so we can kickoff Wednesday?

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/s/ABC-XYZ-449
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4472

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the SOW.

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — XyloTech trial evidence plan

Thanks Olga — that summary looks great and captures what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 600-token median is correct; our max is 1,200 but we want the baseline measured at 600.
- For pass rate on canonical prompts, 85% is our internal bar; we may accept 80% in exchange for clear improvement plan during the trial.
- We will need the KMS key to be customer-managed — I'll share our KMS ARN in the kickoff.

We reviewed the SOW and left two small redlines (commercial on page 2 and a scope callout on page 4). Can you confirm you can accept our small change to the evaluation window (allowing an extra 48 hours for re-runs)? Also Priya and I prefer a Tuesday kickoff if possible — Wednesday would work but we have a major all-hands Tuesday.

I'll sign the SOW pending your confirmation on the re-run window and the kickoff date.

—
Alex Martin
Head of AI Product, XyloTech
alex.martin@xylotech.io
